notes:
2026-09-12: real regression fix — mode-1 scenario no longer fakes a 'Zombie' onto the shared GENERIC_FILLER_CREATURE (Grizzly Bears); uses new PlayerState.creatureCards to seed a real Qutrub Forayer (3/2 Zombie Horror) instead. verify-synergy/vitest clean.

2026-09-12: migrated to the unified Fact/annotations model (fin/29, continuation of the fin/1-27 rollout). Real oracle text (Scryfall-confirmed, mana_cost {W}): '{1}{W}, {T}, Exile this artifact: Choose one — / Return target creature card with mana value 4 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. / Exile target Skeleton, Spirit, or Zombie.' 6 SOURCE + 2 SINK facts, all annotated (card added to ANNOTATED_CARD_SLUGS, baked via compute-annotations.mjs; weights via compute-weights.mjs --slug=phoenix-down).

Baseline: self-cast ({event:'cast', from:'Hand', target:'self'}, typeLine-anchored 'Artifact'), self-enters ({event:'entersBattlefield', to:'Battlefield', subject:'self', target:'self'}, same anchor).

Cost-payment facts: this activation cost has TWO real self-referencing cost components ({T} and 'Exile this artifact'), both modeled as SOURCE facts by analogy to the existing sacrifice/tap-as-cost precedent ({event:'tap'|'exile', subject:'self', target:'self'}) rather than Cloudbound Moogle's SINK-shaped discard-as-cost fact — flagging, not silently resolving, the real house-style inconsistency documented in SYNERGY_DESIGN.md (discard-as-cost landed SINK per explicit user instruction; sacrifice/tap-as-cost landed SOURCE by analogy) since self-exile is closer in spirit to sacrifice/tap (a permanent's own cost-driven removal from play) than to discarding a card from hand. Neither cost fact can ever have real trace evidence: engine.ts's unsupportedCostComponent doesn't recognize '{T}, Exile this artifact' as payable at all (not pure mana/{T}, not the one accepted 'Sacrifice another/a/two X' pattern), so this card's own activated ability can never be piloted through canActivateAbility/activateAbility — confirmed genuinely unpilotable, hence this card's scenarios.ts stays plain harness.ts Scenario style (mode-gated custom effects), not engine-trace.ts. Added a new general (not per-card) isSelfExileActivationCostFact exemption mirroring isSelfTapActivationCostFact exactly, including the same real false-pass risk it guards against (this card's OWN mode-1 'exile target Skeleton, Spirit, or Zombie' effect genuinely produces real {event:'exile'} trace evidence that would otherwise wrongly satisfy the self-exile-cost fact by bare event-name equality).

Real modal ability, exactly 2 scenarios (one per real mode, per the user's own 'more than 1 scenario only for a very significant reason' standing rule — mutually exclusive modes qualify):
- Mode 0 (reanimation): new SOURCE fact {event:'entersBattlefield', from:'Graveyard', to:'Battlefield', controller:'you', target:{types:{has:['Creature']}, cmc:{max:4}}, targeted:true, tapped:true} — first real Graveyard->Battlefield fact in the pool; added a new named ZONE_MOVEMENT_NAMES entry ({from:'Graveyard', to:'Battlefield', name:'reanimate'}) after confirming zero prior pool usage of this (from,to) pair. Companion SINK {to:'Graveyard', controller:'you', types:{has:['Creature']}, cmc:{max:4}} mirrors the real 'creature card with mana value 4 or less' restriction exactly (narrower than the OLD pre-migration sink, which had no cmc filter at all).
- Mode 1 (removal): new SOURCE fact {event:'exile', target:{types:{hasAny:['Skeleton','Spirit','Zombie']}}, targeted:true} — genuinely new event:'exile' vocabulary (checked: zero prior pool usage in either role). Modeled as a bare event tag (not an inline to:'Exile' zone fact) by direct analogy to destroy-act staying bare — a real, targeted, not-always-satisfiable removal act, same shape class. Companion SINK {to:'Battlefield', types:{hasAny:['Skeleton','Spirit','Zombie']}} (unchanged from the pre-migration file, just re-spelled to the unified schema) — TypeConstraint.hasAny is the correct 'any of these three subtypes' vocabulary, already established (not a new addition).

Promoted verify-synergy.mjs's producedEvents/case 'moveTo' AND case 'ceasesToExist' to also recognize a real moveTo/ceasesToExist into zone:'Exile' as {event:'exile'} evidence (general, pool-wide, not per-card — same 'landing on the battlefield always triggers entersBattlefield' promotion pattern already applied to that event; needed BOTH cases since this card's own mode-1 scenario exiles a TOKEN Zombie, which harness.ts logs as ceasesToExist not moveTo per real 111.7). Zero risk to the rest of the pool today (checked: no other card declares event:'exile' yet) but DOES surface ~43 real pool-wide fn:'moveTo'/zone:'Exile' trace lines as new SOFT notes (produced-but-unexplained) on other cards that already exile something without declaring a matching fact — same accepted, non-fatal, note-not-fail side effect the 'pump' promotion caused pool-wide.

Real find-synergies.mjs diff (isolated swap against the pre-migration HEAD file): BEFORE 94 lines, AFTER 49 lines. Gained: +39 new 'enters the battlefield' matches via the new self-enters baseline fact (didn't exist pre-migration — the old file had no baseline self-cast/self-enters facts at all). Reanimate's own 12 'reanimate'-labeled matches are the IDENTICAL card set the old file's own (incorrectly unconstrained-by-type) 'reanimate' fact happened to match — the new Creature+cmc target filter cost zero real matches here. Lost: all 88 reverse graveyard-presence/dies matches (82 'graveyard presence' + 6 'dies') that the OLD sink used to get purely because it had NO cmc filter at all — this is a REAL, PRE-EXISTING model gap, not a mistake: CardDefinition has no generically-populated numeric cmc field (`cmc?: number` is deliberately omit-unless-a-card's-own-effect-needs-it, per its own doc comment), so `staticAttrsFor`'s `cmc: card.cmc` resolves to `undefined` for virtually every pool card, and `satisfiesNum` treats an undefined value as an automatic non-match for ANY cmc-constrained sink — meaning the new, textually-honest `cmc:{max:4}` filter (matching the real 'mana value 4 or less' oracle clause) currently cannot be satisfied by any producer regardless of their real cost. Kept the honest constraint rather than dropping it to preserve match count (same 'correctness over match count' precedent as this project's own Vehicle-vs-Artifact fix) — flagged in engine notes.md as an open, pool-wide gap (a computed-cmc-from-manaCost field for the synergy matcher specifically) worth a future pass, not something to silently work around per-card. event:'exile' itself: 0 matches either direction, expected (new, forward-looking vocabulary, same 'pump' promotion pattern).

verify-synergy.mjs scoped (phoenix-down): 0 hard failures. Full pool (315 checked): 9 pre-existing hard failures, ALL unrelated to this card's own changes (ashe-princess-of-dalmasca, cloudbound-moogle, crystal-fragments-summon-alexander, delivery-moogle, dion-bahamut-s-dominant-bahamut-warden-of-light, dwarven-castle-guard, fate-of-the-sun-cryst, summon-knights-of-round, ultima-origin-of-oblivion) — traced each to missing event:cast/sacrifice/grantKeyword/destroy/addMana evidence-check machinery, i.e. exemption functions that exist in SYNERGY_DESIGN.md's own written history but are currently ABSENT from verify-synergy.mjs on disk. Root cause found live during this task: an unrelated concurrent session ran `git stash` (capturing a large in-flight verify-synergy.mjs/harness.ts/annotation-coverage.mjs/magitek-infantry diff, still sitting unpopped in stash@{0} as of this writing) before committing an unrelated 'Remove dead forge-model code (GPL-3.0 exposure cleanup)' change — NOT touched/resolved here, flagged to the orchestrator as a cross-session coordination item rather than acted on unilaterally mid-task. `npx vitest run functional-model`: 238/238 passed (unaffected by the stash issue — these 9 cards' regressions aren't covered by a vitest suite, only by verify-synergy.mjs).
knownGaps: cmc:{max:4} on both the reanimate SOURCE fact and its companion graveyard SINK fact is textually accurate but currently unmatchable pool-wide: CardDefinition has no generically-populated numeric cmc field (see synergy.ts's staticAttrsFor/card.ts's own CardDefinition.cmc doc comment) for the synergy matcher to resolve via subject-based resolution.

Neither self-tap-cost nor self-exile-cost SOURCE fact can ever have real trace evidence: engine.ts's unsupportedCostComponent doesn't recognize this card's own '{T}, Exile this artifact' cost as payable, so canActivateAbility/activateAbility can never pilot this card's ability at all (a general engine limitation, not per-card) — both facts rely on a general verify-synergy.mjs exemption (isSelfTapActivationCostFact / new isSelfExileActivationCostFact) instead.
